answer: Resist sybils with a post-submit liveness lottery and an attestor-entropy cap. After an answer lands, a brief zephyr window opens: the chain publishes a nonce mixed from epoch seed and address, and only that key's timely signature counts. If one signer plays raven to a nest of silent keys, most nonces expire unsigned, so parked farms fail admission. Weight equals unique attested work times attestor entropy; habitual co-signers collapse to one node. A public saffron risk index haircuts colliding clocks or phrasing and slashes the bond, so extra keys spend capital and signatures, not votes.
